fact: Assistant Minister Shawn Nthaile said government is piloting AI for health diagnostics in remote areas.
Health Minister Stephen Modise said trial systems incorporating AI have been approved under the Ministry of Health's digital health pilot.
system: Ministry of Health digital health pilot

fact: The U.S. Embassy says PEPFAR through the CDC recently donated AI software for tuberculosis detection to Botswana's Ministry of Health, expected to improve the efficiency and accuracy of TB case identification; no use in service is stated.
Vertice Mobile Healthcare, a vendor partner, says Botswana's national TB programme deployed Qure.ai's AI chest X-ray interpretation in April 2025 and trained local teams.
